reverse.description: Moves receptors/notes toward reverse scroll behavior.
reverse.videoNote: Used function: addModifier("reverse"), then set/ease reverse to value 1.

drunk.description: Applies sinusoidal horizontal movement based on distance/beat.
drunk.videoNote: Used function: addModifier("drunk"), then set/ease drunk to value 1.

tipsy.description: Applies sinusoidal vertical movement to lanes.
tipsy.videoNote: Used function: addModifier("tipsy"), then set/ease tipsy to value 1.

beat.description: Pulses note movement according to the song beat.
beat.videoNote: Used function: addModifier("beat"), then set/ease beat to value 1.

bumpy.description: Offsets notes on the Z axis for pseudo-depth waves.

boost.description: Changes scroll distance curve to speed notes near receptors.

bounce.description: Adds bouncing motion to note paths.

stealth.description: Controls note/receptor visibility and alpha-style effects.

x.description: Moves notes/receptors in X, Y, and Z space.

invert.description: Swaps lane positions around the center.

opponentSwap.description: Swaps player and opponent lane fields.

flip.description: Equivalent lane flip behavior exposed through related lane transforms.

rotate.description: Rotates the field or arrow coordinates.

localrotate.description: Rotates lanes around their local origin.

centerrotate.description: Rotates around a centered field origin.

orient.description: Orients notes toward their path direction.

zoom.description: Applies zoom-like scaling to the modchart field.

tornado.description: Warps lanes in a tornado-like curve.

arrowshape.description: Uses a custom CSV shape/path for arrow placement.

noteTweenAngle.description: Psych-style note tween angle compatibility modifier.

noteTweenDirection.description: Psych-style note tween direction compatibility modifier.
